scientific_integrity: Previously known symmetric-form association-scheme eigenvalues, rank counts, quadratic Gauss identities and Euler product identity are credited. The assessed theorem concerns absolute Fourier projection norms and their two-term limit.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime powers only; full rank-one quadratic frequency image including zero; first two terms of fixed-field dimension expansion. Historical priority beyond inspected scheme papers is unresolved.
title: Exact Veronese Fourier-projection norms and a parity-sensitive second term
